_comment: Eight genre modes, one per tile on the home grid. Each is a stored query specification (spec §06) — required_tags names a genre tag, so adding 'Mecha' or 'Sports' is another entry here plus questions carrying the tag, never a deploy. seed.py's check_mode_margins refuses the import unless each mode has question_count x2 matching questions.

modes.name: Shonen
modes.blurb: Tournament arcs, power-ups and shouted attack names.

modes.name: Shoujo
modes.blurb: Transfer students, blushing confessions and enormous eyes.

modes.name: Seinen
modes.blurb: Grown-up, grim and usually about the cost of something.

modes.name: Slice of Life
modes.blurb: Nothing happens, beautifully, for twelve episodes.

modes.name: Romance
modes.blurb: Two people who will confess in the finale, or not at all.

modes.name: Isekai
modes.blurb: Truck-kun, a status screen and a second chance.

modes.name: Comedy
modes.blurb: Reaction faces, running gags and no plot to speak of.

modes.name: Fantasy
modes.blurb: Magic systems, elves, and a dungeon somebody has to clear.
